I have resolved the issue by updating the MySQL database backend to use the `database` and `password` connection parameters instead of the deprecated `db` and `passwd` arguments:

- Updated [`DatabaseWrapper.get_connection_params()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-79sxfxd_/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py#L194-L230) in [base.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-79sxfxd_/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py) to pass `database` and `password` instead of `db` and `passwd`.
- Updated [`DatabaseClient.settings_to_cmd_args_env()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-79sxfxd_/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py#L8-L60) in [client.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-79sxfxd_/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py) to check for `database` in `OPTIONS` (falling back to `db` and `NAME`).
